caption:
Before you pay for any AI tool, check what you can get free.

Perplexity Pro, Gemini Pro and ChatGPT Go were all offered free to Indian users in recent months, and NotebookLM is free. Offers vary by eligibility and can change, so read the terms before you sign up.

Our rule: one tool per job. Research, your own notes, writing.

Source: Social Samosa, Digit.
